steps.note: S1.1.1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch a,c, supported by the line-748 quote that rows 6 and 7 restore c,a, and S1.1.1's motivation gives the subtract-first, restore-last reason.

S1.1.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 and the self coefficient one, but says only that the side wires cancel 'the unwanted neighbour cases' without stating they are the intersection-one cases (its quote stops at 'cancels exactly the', and the plan never defines neighbours by intersection size), so marked absent as unsure.
S1.1.1.2 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 but never says the side wires cancel intersections zero and two (only 'the unwanted neighbour cases', merged with the bit case).
S1.1.1.3 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with every auxiliary wire restored, quoting line 761.
S1.1.3.3 says every edge joins comparable labels but the plan gives no per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table at 1022-1043).

S1.1.3.2 states the inclusion P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp because t_X perp t_Y (quoting line 953), but not the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp or its dimension h-2, so only half of the defining content is there.

The plan states that the only decreasing edge is center 3->4 losing h, sources N and sinks Wm-N, the telescoped signed sum Wm-2N, and Ic decreasing edges giving L=Ich and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, with quotes at lines 891, 1061, 1066 and 1070.

The plan uses orthonormal residual bases (S2.1.2) but never says that over F_2 each nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, or that alternating planes are absorbed to get an orthonormal basis.
S1.1.4.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, quoting line 1110.

S2.1's method says Hamming weight is additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, but the plan never states the resulting decomposition q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal residual basis of wt(v)[v.x], jumping straight to one kernel per basis vector.
The plan asserts the translation kernel aI+bX_v (S2.1, S2.1.2) but not that wt(v) is odd so the phase is i^{eps[v.x]}, nor that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns the character into the translation.

S2.1.2 gives one kernel per orthonormal residual vector and S2.1.5 (quoting line 1905, where the paper uses this) gives exactly s_c child calls, each a kernel acting on the f columns of one slot, which is the tensored-factor count.

Nothing in the plan states the endpoint frames (I for the zero label, C^{(x)m} for the full label), the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} repair, or the negation of the X outputs; S2.1.1 only lists C^{-1}=-iZCZ.
S1.1.4.3 gives both loss ratios below 1/2 and S1.1.4.5 states the deficit N-2L_b>0 so s_b<W_b m (quoting line 1167).
S1.1.4.6 states eta_b = 339/22587335000000, matching line 1322.
The plan never gives eta_c = 73/19906842167500.

S1.1.4.6 states the deficits exceed 20*2^-50 (its line-1331 quote says both), the chain m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-20*2^-50) > m(1-eta), and s/W < m^tau with tau=1-2^-50; only the elementary reason log m < 20 for the first inequality is left unstated.

S1.1.5.1's method and its two infers give the topmost-row rightmost-entry pivot, clearing by lower-triangular row and column operations, deleting the pivot row and column and repeating, and Pi with exactly a ones.

The plan works over Z/q^bZ (S1.1.5) but never says q is a fixed odd prime chosen to avoid every denominator in the finite table of factors so the identities and invertible triangular factors specialize.
S1.1.5.2 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, quoting line 1425.
S1.1.5.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, using one interchange per one of Pi with a ones, matching lines 1436-1443.
S2.4 names Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) and S2.4.1 uses E, but the plan never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2.

S2.4.1 states A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e) <= 8e at a leaf, with s rather than s/W because depths concatenate (quoting line 2515); the count showing the per-invocation work is below E is not given.
The plan does not unroll the recurrence: no B^{k+1} <= B^2 d^nu, no A(e) <= 8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and no derivation that the total stays below C_0 d^{C_1}.
S2.4.2-S2.4.4 state that depth ell gives values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ell, that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and that eps C_1 < 1 gives Delta=o(p).
S2.5 states every row of H_0^{(x)D} has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p, quoting line 2751.

summary: P04 has 14 of 26 sub-steps present (B 2/4, L 2/5, P 1/4, R 3/4, M 3/4, S 3/5) and none wrong. It carries the scratch-independence and three-stage exchange, the dimension telescoping and loss ratios, the rank deficit with eta_b and the exponent comparison, the elimination factorization, the triangular cost and the per-one interchange, and the depth recurrence, bit widths and row-sum truncation. It omits the intersection-size cases cancelled by the side wires, the residual table and the side-edge complement, the F_2 orthonormal-basis argument, the phase decomposition and Hadamard step, the endpoint-frame repair, eta_c, the choice of prime, the layer constants and the unrolling of the recurrence.
